reviews.text: Excellent service. Very quick response to request for service.

reviews.text: We are very happy that we chose A&M Electric to install a whole house generator. Everyone that came to the house acted in a professional and personal manner. They explained what they were doing and answered any questions when we asked.

reviews.text: Professional delivery in all aspects of service. Installed a Kohler generator fir us. The job required extra thought in application, but AMJ (Andrew) handled the situation nicely. The try to do there best in every aspect of delivery.
